content.description:
Main goals of the Mutant project: Dev team working full time on Plutus Platform to develop the project with smart contracts. Release of 5 mutant factions NFTs, that will be used as your Hero on the future online card game*. Each faction will have their own unique style and attributes. Holders will be able to take part on some team’s decisions. Create NFTs with amazing art style and functionality. So you will be able to use it as profile picture, game hero, as income generator (through % of the royalties) and as any other possibility that may appear in the future.
